# Version 4.155.0
> **Text shaping and renderer updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and HarfBuzz 14.4.0, with RAW decoding retired.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use a separate RAW or DNG decoder** — Built-in RAW/DNG development and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement decoder is included. Decode those containers with another library and pass supported pixels or images to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates decoding support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **Skia m155** — Updates the bundled renderer to m155 while preserving the rotation-scale text-run bounds contract and the existing managed binding surface. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081))
- **HarfBuzz 14.4.0** — Updates the native shaping engine with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping and subsetting improvements. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed-flush caches and font matching** — Drops uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes and checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted FontConfig candidate, allowing the caller to try the next requested family. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 with intentional mark-positioning changes and malformed-font fixes. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.

## Release Candidate 1 (October 12, 2026)

Corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and FontConfig first-candidate matching.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13...v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

## Preview 2 (September 29, 2026)

Updated native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and added OpenType tag enums. Retired built-in RAW/DNG decoding without removing the public format enum.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14...v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13)
